metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.2 · 2004 · Masti
metas.description: Unhappy with their marriages, best friends, Meet, Prem and Amar, decide to cheat on their wives - but instead become the prime suspects in a murder investigation.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.5 · 2013 · Grand Masti
metas.description: Meet, Prem, and Amar look to have a blast at their college reunion, though they soon find themselves in another predicament.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.7 · 2016 · Great Grand Masti
metas.description: Amar, Meet and Prem go into a small town where they encounter a 'femme fatale' in the form of Ragini. Ragini is everything they had dreamed of, but she slowly turns into their worst nightmare!
